name: 3-D Man's Goggles
deck: A gift from the original 3-D Man to Delroy Garrett, which proved to be extremely useful to detect skrulls. Nothing beats "old-school".

name: Absorbing Man's Ball and Chain
deck: Ball and chain which can also magically possesses the same properties of transformation as his body.

name: Adamantium
deck: A virtually indestructible man-made metal. The strongest metal known. Unbreakable and razor-sharp, it cuts through steel like a paper. Without a healing factor it is poisonous inside the body.

name: Adhesive X
deck: Chemical created by Baron Zemo, that could bond with anything.

name: Ahl-Quito
deck: A legendary alien sword.

name: All-Black The Necrosword
deck: All-Black the Necrosword is a powerful and dangerous Klyntar with dark properties, created by Knull, the God of the Symbiotes, and later taken by Gorr the God Butcher, after Knull crashed onto his planet following a battle with another god. The Necrosword is capable of slaying gods, clashing with beings such as Galactus, and consuming others such as Ego the Living Planet.

name: All-New, All-Different Iron Man Suit
deck: Iron Man Model Prime Armor, or Model 51. This suit is essentially all of Tony's suits merged into one. It is built up by tiny hexagons making it able to reshape into weapons and tools.

name: Amulet of Right
deck: The item chosen by the Chosen One rather than the Sword of Might, thus transforming him or her into Captain Britain.

name: Ant-Man's Gas Canisters
deck: Canisters used by Ant-Man which contain Pym Particles needed to shrink and enlarge.

name: Ant-Man's Helmet
deck: A cybernetic helmet developed by Hank Pym. Allows rudimentary communication with ants and other insects.

name: Anti-Matter Screen
deck: One of the most potent defense created by Kang the Conqueror. It is capable of instantly disintegrating any earthly matter it may touch.

name: Avengers Communicard
deck: An advanced communication device used by the Avengers

name: Avengers Deep Space Monitor Station
deck: A monitoring station used by the Avengers and maintained by Quasar. It served as a base to the short-lived cosmic Avengers team.

name: Avengers Quincruiser
deck: The Avengers main form of transport through space. A modified version of the traditional Quinjet.

name: Avengers Quinjet
deck: The Avengers private jet.

name: Avengers Submarine
deck: Submarine the Avengers used.

name: Axe of Ares
deck: God of War's, battle axe.

name: Beetle Armor Mk. I
deck: The original Beetle armor created and worn by Abe Jenkins.

name: Black Knight's Atomic Steed
deck: A means of transport used by Black Knight and adapted from one created by Knights of Wundagore.

name: Black Knight's Photonic Sword
deck: Weapon used by Black Knight after he abandoned the Ebony Blade.

name: Black Knight's Power Lance
deck: A lance which fires energy blasts used by the evil Black Knight. Dane Whitman used it in his earliest exploits before he began using the Ebony Blade.

name: Black Mariah
deck: U.S.Agent's air ship.

name: Black Panther's Energy Daggers
deck: Energy Daggers are T'Challa's standard weapon of choice.

name: Black Widow's Gauntlets
deck: The gauntlets used by the Black Widow. They are famous for delivering the Widow Bite.

name: Blackbird
deck: Manufactured by Lockheed, the SR-71 "Blackbird" was a top-secret, long-range reconnaissance aircraft; forerunner to the first true "stealth" aircraft and the fastest conventional airplane ever built. The X-Men have used many variants of the Blackbird over the years, thus it’s known by many names: "X-Jet", "Supersoinc" and "Hypersonic".

name: Blacklash's Whip
deck: Cybernetic whip used by the Iron Man foe Whiplash/Blacklash (Scarlotti).

name: Blinding Brazier of Balthakk
deck: An artifact of power created by the entity Balthakk. The first human to touch the item is given a portion of his power, becoming Inferno.

name: Book of the Skull
deck: The book of the Skull is magical.

name: Box Armor
deck: large humanoid robot armor which was created by Roger Bochs.

name: Bucky's Bionic Arm
deck: A bionic arm Bucky Barnes received by Soviet scientists when he became the Winter Soldier.

name: Bullseye's Bow
deck: A bow used by Bullseye when he was acting under the name of Hawkeye.

name: Captain America Armor
deck: When Captain America was completely paralyzed by his Super-Soldier Serum-induced illness, Tony Stark created for him an exoskeleton armor which allowed him to move.

name: Captain America's Energy Shield
deck: Shield used by Captain America when he lost his traditional shield. Later re-used again when he was active as Commander Rogers.

name: Captain America's Motorcycle
deck: Specially modified Harley-Davidson. Used by Captain America for a street level means of transportation.

name: Captain America's Original Shield
deck: Captain America's first shield, before adopting his more famous disc shaped shield. Most recently used by the Young Avengers' Patriot.

name: Captain America's Shield
deck: Captain America's shield has become the symbol and embodiment of justice and patriotism.

name: Captain Marvel's Uni-Beam
deck: A weapon of The Kree Imperial Army modified by Mar-Vell to fit on his wrist. It was Captain Marvel's primary weapon.

name: Cerebro
deck: Cerebro (now known as Cerebra) is a large computer device inside the X-Mansion that acts as a conduit and magnifier for telepaths. It is used primarily as a way to locate mutants and was created by Professor Charles Xavier.

name: Chameleon's Base Mask
deck: Chameleon designed his base mask to hide his true identity and so other mask can be fitted quickly and securely.

name: Cloak of Levitation
deck: Doctor Strange's mystical cloak.

name: Collector's Ship
deck: A skycraft called the Collector's Case used by The Collector.

name: Constrictor's Cybernetic Cables
deck: Electrially-powered cables used by Constrictor as his primary weapon.

name: Cosmic Cube
deck: Cosmic Cubes are among the most powerful objects in the universe. They are created out of energy from another dimension. Anyone in possession of the cosmic cube can use it to reshape (mold) reality to mirror their vision.

name: Crimson Dynamo Armor
deck: The Crimson Dynamo is an armor worn by many in the service of the Russian (formally USSR) government, some good, some evil.

name: Crimson Gem of Cyttorak
deck: A jewel of power created by the mystical entity Cyttorak, Lord of the Crimson Cosmos. The Gem is the means of giving a human a portion of his power. Thus becoming his avatar, the unstoppable Juggernaut.

name: Cyclops' Visor
deck: The visor Cyclops uses to control his laser eye discharge. It contains powdered ruby-quartz crystal.

name: Daredevil's Billy Club
deck: Daredevil's signature weapon is his specially designed billy club, which he created.

name: Darkhawk Amulet
deck: An otherworldly relic also known as the Raptor Amulet that belonged to the Shi'ar operatives of the Fraternity of Raptors. Powerful Items used to transform into Darkhawk Androids.

name: Destiny Force
deck: A mysterious and near-infinite power source inherent in all of humanity.

name: Django Maximoff's Marionettes
deck: Marionette puppets of Quicksilver and the Scarlet Witch, made by Mr. Doll, which once held both of the Avengers souls.

name: Doctor Doom's Armor
deck: Doctor Doom's Armor is a nuclear-powered, computer-assisted battle suit. It was magically forged at a monastery in Tibet.

name: Doctor Doom's Time Platform
deck: Time machine owned and created by Victor von Doom. Housed in Castle Doom. The Time Platform is used to send more than one person back in time, either in the past or future.

name: Doctor Octopus' Arms
deck: Doctor Octopus's arms are four mechanical appendages that he uses as his primary weapon and is able to control each of them through a special link. They are capable of both great strength and delicate procedures.

name: Dragonfang
deck: The sword wielded by the Asgardian goddess and adventurer Valkyrie.

name: Dry-Dock
deck: The Space Station of the Guardians of the Galaxy

name: Dust of Death
deck: The Dust of Death (aka Red Dust) is a weapon of Red Skull which when inhaled causes the victim's skin to shrivel so their head takes on the appearance of Red Skull.

name: Ebony Blade
deck: Black Knight's sword that can cut through anything.

name: Element Gun
deck: Star-Lord's element gun is capable of projecting any element he wants be it fire, water, earth wind or even lightning.

name: Evil Eye
deck: Power object of Avalon which projects force blasts, disintegration rays, force fields, and can nullify other energy sources.

name: Eye of Agamotto
deck: A mystical artifact used by the Sorcerer Supreme.

name: Faithbreaker
deck: Faithbreaker is an enchanted hammer that was originally wielded by Mokk. Its current owner is the Grey Gargoyle.

name: Falcon's Wings
deck: Artificial wings created by Black Panther which are worn by the Falcon.

name: Fantasti-Car MK I
deck: Now an obselete piece of transportation for the Fantastic Four, this was also known as the "Flying Bathub."

name: Fantasti-Car MK II
deck: This was the second version of the Fantasti-Car MK I.

name: Fantastic Four Signal Device
deck: The specially designed signal flare device of the Fantastic Four.

name: Fearsome Fist of Farallah
deck: An artifact of power created by the entity Farallah. The first human to touch the item is given a portion of its power, becoming Carnivore.

name: Forever Crystal
deck: An immense chronal power.

name: Gamma Bomb
deck: The Gamma Bomb was created by Bruce Banner, the subsequent testing of which caused him to be transformed into the Incredible Hulk. It was commissioned by the US Military and designed to release powerful Gamma Rays.

name: Gamma Ray Projector
deck: The Gamma Ray Projector was a device that projected beams of gamma radiation.

name: Ghost Rider's Bike
deck: The demonically-altered bike of Ghost Rider. It's so fast that by the friction of the road, the tires burst into flames.

name: Ghost Rider's Car
deck: Ghost Rider's Hell Charger.

name: Ghost Rider's Six-Shooter
deck: Six-shooter used by the original Ghost Rider/Phantom Rider.

name: Ghost-Tech Suit
deck: Battlesuit created and worn by Ghost which enables him to become intangible.

name: Giant Man's Cybernetic Helmet
deck: Helmet worn by Giant Man for a brief time which allowed him to communicate with ants.

name: Goblin Formula
deck: Based on the notes from Professor Mendel Stromm, Norman Osborn attempted to perfect the formula to see if he could cash in on them.

name: Goblin Glider
deck: The Green Goblin's primary mode of transport. Eventually he would be impaled on it when he was trying to kill Spider-Man. Aside from the Green Goblin, the Goblin Glider was also used by the Hobgoblin, Demogoblin, and Menace.

name: Godstone
deck: Mysterious red jewel found by John Jameson on the Moon. The Moongem transformed Jameson into the Man-Wolf, then later the lupine Star-God. Also called the Godstone.

name: Golden Mace
deck: Hercules possesses an indestructible Golden Mace forged of Adamantine by the Olympian armorer Hephaestus.

name: Green Goblin's Broomstick
deck: The Green Goblin's flying device used in his first appearance. He later discarded it in favor of a Goblin Glider.

name: Grim Reaper's Scythe
deck: A mechanical scythe Eric Williams (a.k.a. Grim Reaper) wears in place of his missing right hand.

name: Gungnir
deck: Gungnir or The Spear of Heaven is an indestructible spear wielded by the the monarch of Asgard, Odin.

name: Hamburger
deck: A sandwich made with a ground beef patty and usually served between two slices of bread, typically a sesame seed bun. Cheese is usually added, and condiments such as ketchup, mustard are optional.

name: Hammer of Skadi
deck: This Asgardian artifact fell from the sky because of rituals performed by the original Red Skull. It wasn't able to be lifted by Adolf Hitler or the Red Skull but just recently the Skull's daughter Sin was able to lift it, transforming into the goddess Skadi herself.

name: Hawkeye's Bow
deck: Hawkeye's famous bow.

name: Hawkeye's Quiver
deck: Specially designed quiver used by Hawkeye.

name: Heart Shaped Herb
deck: The Heart of Wakanda or Heart Shaped Herb is a Wakandan plant whose juices and phyto-nutrients grant special abilities to those of noble and worthy blood.

name: High Evolutionary's Armor
deck: High Evolutionary's Armor provides its wearer with protection against physical, energy, psionic, or magical attacks.

name: Hofund
deck: Hofud is Heimdall's sword.

name: Hogun's Mace
deck: Hogun the Grim's weapon of choice.

name: Horde Crusher
deck: A staff created by Arnim Zola and stolen by his son, Nomad.

name: Horn of Proteus
deck: An Atlantean artifact that summons and controls underwater behemoths such as Giganto.

name: Iliad
deck: S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier.

name: Image Inducer
deck: A technological object used by superhumans with unusual appearances to disguise themselves as normal human beings. It can also be used to take on the appearance of others.

name: Infinity Gems
deck: The Infinity Gems are six precious stones of cosmic origin that give the possessor mastery over a certain power. Collecting and using all six gems will give the wielder complete control over the universe.

name: Inhuman Codex
deck: The Inhuman Codex is an databank featuring Inhuman DNA and it can be used to disable Inhumans of their powers.

name: Iron Man Armor
deck: Tony Stark has designed and built a variety of armors which he uses as Iron Man. Their appearance and capabilities are continually evolving as Tony modifies and upgrades his technology.

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. I
deck: Iron Man's first armor.

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. II
deck: Iron Man's second model armor, almost identical to his first but except upgraded, and with a gold finish to appear less intimidating.

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. III
deck: Tony Stark's 2nd model Iron Man armor and his first Red and Gold colored armor.

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. IV
deck: Model 04 Iron Man Armor.

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. V
deck: Tony Stark's Iron Man Model 04 armor and one of his longest enduring armors.

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. VII
deck: Model 8 Iron Man armor - popularly known as Iron Man's "Silver Centurion" armor.

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. VIII
deck: Iron Man Model 09 Armor, the "Neo-Classic" armor.

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. XI
deck: Iron Man's "Modular Armor".

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. XII
deck: The Model 16 armor was designed by Stark specifically for combat. He wore this armor during The Crossing up until his death.

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. XIII
deck: Tony Stark's armor upon his return to Earth following Heroes Reborn. Known as his "Renaissance Armor", "Heroes Reborn Armor", and "Sentient Armor".

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. XIV
deck: Iron Man armor Model 21.

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. XV
deck: Stark's Model 29 armor which he wore while the head of the Department of Defense.

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. XVI
deck: Iron Man Armor Model 30, better known as his Extremis armor.

name: Iron Man Armor Mk. XVII
deck: Iron Man's "Bleeding Edge" armor, worn by Tony Stark from the Heroic Age until Marvel NOW. It is stored in Stark's body as nano-bots powered by Repulsor Tech and controled by upgraded version of Extremis. It's so advanced that it's technology was used even in next millennium and seen as Stark as much more than just Extremis upgrade. It increased Stark's powers to a whole new level and granted him even more abilities.

name: Iron Man Armor Model 70
deck: After stepping down from Stark Unlimited, Tony Stark swore off advanced technology and his arsenal of suits, instead resorting to a single vintage-style armor.

name: Iron Man Phoenix-Buster Armor Mk. I
deck: The armor used by Tony Stark with the hopes of destroying the Phoenix Force.

name: Iron Man Space Armor Mk. I
deck: Iron Man Model 05 armor designed for extended use in space.

name: Iron Man Space Armor Mk. II
deck: Used by Iron Man during Operation Galactic Storm.

name: Iron Man Space Armor Mk. III
deck: Iron Man's "Godkiller" armor and current space armor.

name: Iron Man Thorbuster Armor Mk. I
deck: The Thorbuster armor. It combines Stark technology with Asgardian magic. Stark designed and based it off of the destroyer armor.

name: Iron Man's Briefcase
deck: A special briefcase Tony Stark designed to easily transport his Iron Man armor.

name: Iron Patriot Armor
deck: A suit of armor originally designed for Norman Osborn during his tenure as leader of the Avengers. The third version was piloted by James Rhodes while the fourth & fifth are piloted by Dr Toni Ho

name: Iron Spider Costume
deck: The Iron Spider was a gift from Iron Man given to Peter Parker. It was later used by the Initiative Red Team, the Scarlet Spiders.

name: ISO-36
deck: Its a serum which is created in the West Coast. It has some relations with radioactivity. It's used to cure Aunt May from a unknown radioactive poison in her blood.

name: Isotope 16
deck: Kept under 24-hour guard at Fort Tyson in an easily-recognizable platinum container, the isotope 16 was stolen by Spider-Man, who was at the moment struck with amnesia, as instructed by his partner in crime Doctor Octopus. It was needed to perfect Nullifier, but Doc Ock couldn't use it before being defeated and taken into custody by the military.

name: Ivory Idol of Ikonn
deck: An artifact of power created by the demon Ikonn. The first human to touch the item is given a portion of its power, becoming Bedlam.

name: Jarnbjorn
deck: The axe Thor wielded before he was worthy of wielding Mjolnir.

name: Juggernaut's Helmet
deck: The Juggernaut's helmet. It protects its wearer from any mental/telepathic/psychic properties.

name: Kang Armor
deck: Kang's neuro-kinetic battle armor.

name: Kang's Time Ship
deck: Kang the Conqueror's ship, the exterior of which is modelled to resemble an Egyptian Sphinx.

name: Kestrel Key of Krakkan
deck: An artifact of power created by the entity Krakkan. The first human to touch the item is given a portion of its power, becoming Conquest.

name: Klaw's Blaster
deck: Primary weapon used by Klaw which fires concussive beams of sound.

name: Krakoan Gates
deck: The Gateways are created from a type of flowers that grow on Krakoa, the new mutant nation.

name: Kraven's Lion's Head Vest
deck: Worn by Kraven the Hunter, his Lion's Head Vest contains all sorts of gimmicks including his infamous laser-firing nipples.

name: Kree Helion
deck: The Kree star ship that first brought Captain Marvel to Earth.

name: Lilandra
deck: A Shi'ar battleship.

name: MACH-I Armor
deck: The first M.A.C.H. armor created and worn by Abe Jenkins. Basically anything a fighter-jet can do, this suit can do in less than half the space.

name: MACH-II Armor
deck: Second in the M.A.C.H. series of armors created and worn by Abe Jenkins.

name: Madame Masque's Data-Encrypted Gold Coin
deck: A data coin containing information about all the Maggia families.

name: Madame Masque's Mask
deck: A solid gold face mask that Whitney Frost wears to hide her scarred face. It was made as a gift for her by Mordecai Midas.

name: Madame Masque's Taser
deck: Main weapon used by Masque when she was an Avenger.

name: Magdalene's Power Lance
deck: Staff used by Magdalene capable of transporting herself and others great distances and even to other dimensions and realities.

name: Magneto's Helmet
deck: Worn by the infamous mutant, Magneto, the helmet can shield him from the highest level telepaths such as Emma Frost, Jean Grey and Charles Xavier.

name: Manbreaker
deck: Manbreaker is the enchanted hammer that is carried by Titania.

name: Mandroid Armor
deck: Armor originally designed by Tony Stark to be used by S.H.I.E.L.D. Now used by both criminal and governmental institutions for various purposes.

name: Mechano-Monster
deck: The Kronans had originally designed this robotic weapon as an aid for their first invasion. It was used however as a super weapon against the almighty Thor.

name: Megingjörð
deck: Megingjörð is Thor's belt.

name: Melter's Chest Beam
deck: Device attached to Melter's chest which "melts" things.

name: Melter's Gun
deck: Melter's gun which "melts" things.

name: Mind Gem
deck: One of the Infinity Gems that taps the user into the universal consciousness, allowing for unlimited manipulation of psionic powers including telepathy and telekinesis.

name: Mjolnir
deck: Mjolnir (pronounced myawl-nir) is the enchanted hammer wielded by Thor. It was forged by the dwarf weaponsmiths Brokk and Eitri after a bet with Loki. The name means crusher or grinder.

name: Mockingbird's Battle Staves
deck: Mockingbird's primary weapon is a pair of steel batons that can also join together to make a staff.

name: Molecular Rearranger
deck: A molecular rearranger is one of the few things that can reshape adamantium.

name: Moon Tractor
deck: The Moon Tractor is a vehicle built by Tony Stark.

name: Moonstone
deck: The Kree Moongem which empowered Moonstone and Nefarius and was later used by Baron Zemo.

name: Nega-Bands
deck: The nega-bands are a Kree weapon worn by Captain Marvel place holders. Both Genis & Mar-Vell were linked to Rick Jones, allowing the two to switch places when the bands are struck together.

name: Nighthawk's Jet-Powered Artificial Wings
deck: A jet-powered system used by Nighthawk. Noted as being similar to Falcon's wings.

name: Nighthawk's Talons
deck: Titanium claws fitted to Nighthawk's glove which are his primary offensive weapon.

name: Nivashi Stone
deck: Magic item formerly used by Django Maximoff.

name: Norn Stones
deck: Magical stones that grant the wielder varied powers...

name: Nova Corps Helmet
deck: Helmet that is part of the Xandar Nova Corps and Black Novas' uniform.

name: Nuclear Weaponry
deck: Nuclear Weaponry are explosive devices that derives its destructive force from nuclear reactions.

name: Obedience Disks
deck: Obedience Disks were used by the Red King of Sakaar to control his prisoners and gladiators. The Hulk later used them on captured heroes during World War Hulk.

name: Oceanbreaker
deck: Oceanbreaker is the enchanted hammer that is carried by Attuma.

name: Odinsword
deck: Odin's personal weapon

name: Omni-Wave Projector
deck: Omni-Wave Projectors were Kree communication technology that allowed the species to send instantaneous messages across the void of hyperspace.

name: Orb of Agamotto
deck: A mystical artifact in possession by Doctor Strange. It is a powerful scrying device used for clairvoyance and magic detection.

name: Paladin's Stun-Gun
deck: A specially designed gun used by Paladin.

name: Panther Habit
deck: Panther Habit is a vibranium laced outfit of Black Panther.

name: Pink Pills
deck: Pills produced by Dr.Zabo (Mr.Hyde) using his Defective Formula. It allows for temporary superpowers to mutate a person into a Mr. Hyde-similar form.

name: Pogo Plane
deck: Created by Reed Richards. This was the Fantastic Four's main way of international and space transport before the second Fantasti-Car.

name: Porcupine's Battle Suit
deck: Battle suit worn by Porcupine. Since Porcupine's death, the suit has remained in Avengers Mansion on display to honor the man who died trying to help them.

name: Power Gem
deck: The power gem allows the user to potentially manipulate all the power and energy in the universe that has, or ever will exist.

name: Power Prism
deck: Doctor Spectrum's primary weapon. Once impersonated by a Skrull.

name: Professor X's Hover Chair
deck: Professor X's Hover Chair

name: Psyche-Magnitron
deck: A Kree industrial device long since outlawed by it's creators. Designed to convert thought into reality, it can conjure up anything the user can mentally conceive of and often bestows superpowers onto those who use it.

name: Pumpkin Bombs
deck: Pumpkin bombs are incendiary grenades.

name: Pym Particles
deck: A class of subatomic particles first discovered by Hank Pym. When used properly they allow a person or object to change size.

name: Quantum Bands
deck: The Quantum Bands are a pair of alien artifacts that give the wearer a variety of powers. Also known as: The Power-Bands of Rinn, or the Uranian Power-Bands.

name: Radioactive Spider
deck: At a science exhibit a radioactive spider bit Peter Parker and turned the teen into the amazing Spider-Man.

name: Ragnarok's Hammer
deck: An electronical-based replica of Thor's hammer; Mjolnir which was wielded by Thor's cyborg clone Ragnarok.

name: Rama-Tut's Ultra-Diode Ray Gun
deck: Gun used by Rama-Tut/Kang which saps the will of it's targets.

name: Razor-Bats
deck: One of many weapons employed by the Green Goblin, Razor Bats are... well, bat-shaped razorblades he throws at people.

name: Reality Gem
deck: Locally or universally alters the natural laws of the universe to the wielders will. The Reality Gem alters reality.

name: Repulsor Beam
deck: A significant weapon associated to the weapons of Tony Stark, his suits, S.H.I.E.L.D. weaponry and others as such

name: Ringed Ruby of Raggadorr
deck: An artifact of power created by the entity Raggadorr. The first human to touch the item is given a portion of its power, becoming Stonecutter.

name: Ringmaster's Hat
deck: A unique hat which has a powerful mind-control device on top.

name: Ruby Quartz
deck: The synthetic crystal used in Cyclops' battle visor and sunglasses. It is the only known substance that effectively blocks his destructive optic blasts.

name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier
deck: The Helicarrier is the mobile vehicle used by SHIELD as their Headquarters of the U.N. Peacekeeping Taskforce. There are at least 10 known.

name: Sai
deck: A three pronged dagger and an Okinawan weapon from Japan used to lock and disarm opponents while either beating an opponent into submission with the pommel or stabbing with the point.

name: Scarlet Centurion's Halberd
deck: Weapon used by Scarlet Centurion.

name: Scorpion's Tail
deck: Scorpion's main offensive weapon.

name: Second Eye of Agamotto
deck: The Second Eye of Agamotto is an enchanted talisman in Sandurang's possession.

name: Sentry's Watchtower
deck: The Watchtower is the base of operations for Sentry.

name: Serpent Crown
deck: One of the most powerful talismens of black magic known to man, the Serpent Crown bears the image of its master, Set, the demon that first brought death into the world.

name: Shield of Night
deck: Shield used by Black Knight which absorbs the energy of attacks allowing him to redirect to through his blade.

name: Size-Change Capsules
deck: Capsules swallowed by Giant man and Wasp to change size.

name: Songbird's Sonic Harness
deck: A harness built by Fixer to channel Songbird's powers.

name: Soul Gem
deck: The Soul gem has the ability to take any soul and modify its container to ones liking.

name: Soulbreaker
deck: Soulbreaker is the enchanted hammer that is carried by the Thing.

name: Soulsword
deck: A magical weapon created from the purest part of Illyana Rasputin's soul during her stay in Limbo.

name: Space Gem
deck: Limitless manipulation of space, allowing for teleportation, dimensional manipulation, creation of wormholes, etc.

name: Sparkle Blasts
deck: One of the Green Goblin/Hobgoblin's many weapons. Small concussive blasts of energy which fire from their finger tips.

name: Spider Signal
deck: Spider-Man's light attached to his belt. Used in the early days to see in the dark and to spook criminals before he pounced upon them.

name: Spider-Man's Belt-Camera
deck: Belt-mounted camera used by Spider-Man to take action shots to later sell to the Daily Bugle.

name: Spider-Man's Suit
deck: Costume of Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man

name: Spider-Man's Utility Belt
deck: A Utility Belt that holds extra web fluid cartridges, Spider-Tracers, an inbuilt spider-signal and holds his camera.

name: Spider-Tracer
deck: Part of Spider-man's equipment, it is used to be attached to any fleeing villain or object so that Spider-Man may track them down later with. It operates on a wave-length detectable by Spider-Man's Spider-Sense.

name: Staff of the Serpent
deck: The Serpent's staff. It is unknown if it holds any of its own enchantments.

name: Star Brand
deck: Essentially the Star Brand is a zero-point energy collector, drawing power from the fabric of space-time itself. It is unlimited in potential, though the upper limits of the star-like tattoo of power are determined by the imagination of its wielder. A paradox, the Star Brand came into being when the universe was compressed into a single point of space for a mere microsecond. It has been wielded by several people in various realities.

name: Starcore One
deck: Starcore One was an orbiting laboratory satellite space station.

name: Stingray Armor
deck: Armored suit created by Walter Newell for deep-sea exploration.

name: Stonebreaker
deck: Stonebreaker is the enchanted hammer that is carried by Juggernaut.

name: Stoneship
deck: Once belonging to the Shadow People, the Sakaar Stoneship was used by the Hulk and his Warbound to travel to Earth.

name: Stormbreaker
deck: Stormbreaker is the enchanted hammer that is carried by Beta Ray Bill. Its enchantments are the same as those of Mjolnir: Thor's enchanted hammer. Stormbreaker was given as a gift to Beta Ray Bill from Odin.

name: Stryfe's Armor
deck: The armor of Stryfe hides his true face...the face of CABLE!!

name: Super Soldier Serum
deck: The Super Soldier Serum was created by Professor Abraham Erskine to enhance baseline humans beyond the peak of human potential, both mentally and physically. The most famous and successful recipient of the process is Steve Rogers, aka Captain America.

name: Superior Spider Suit
deck: Upgraded Spider-Man suit used by The Superior Spider-Man/Doctor Octopus.

name: Sword of Ares
deck: The war god's sword. He usually used an axe but on a few occasions, he utilized a large array of weapons, including this sword.

name: Sword of Fandral
deck: Sword of the Asgardian, Fandral.

name: Sword of Light
deck: Sword used by Black Knight in conjunction with the Shield of Night.

name: Sword of Might
deck: The Sword of Might is offered to any Captain Britain alongside the Amulet of Right, the Sword represents power, but its power comes with a cost.

name: Sword of Sif
deck: Sword of the Adgardian warrior, Sif.

name: Sword of Volstagg
deck: Sword of the Asgardian, Volstagg.

name: Swordsman's Blade
deck: The primary weapon of the Avenger and former villain known as Swordsman. The sword has many ridiculous Silver Age quirks like the ability to fire energy blasts and be shot from it's hilt like a projectile.

name: Synchro-Staff
deck: An artifact belonging to Immortus and used by the Avengers to explore their histories.

name: Taskmaster's Bow
deck: Bow used by Taskmaster. It is notable that Taskmaster also employs specialty arrows similar to Hawkeye. Taskmaster has showcased Sonic Arrows, Explosive Arrows, and Acid Arrows in the past and it is theorized that he has constructed and has access to nearly every Arrow that Hakeye has used previously.

name: Taskmaster's Shield
deck: A circular shield used by Taskmaster. The shield was designed and based off of Captain America's famous weapon. Although this shield is not composed of the unique properties of Vibranium and Adamantium like Captain America's. It has been stated that Taskmaster's shield is constructed from an Osmium Alloy and not nearly as indestructible. The Alloy is strong enough however to withstand attacks from Iron Man, and strikes from Cap's shield itself.

name: Taskmaster's Sword
deck: Taskmaster's sword. The composition is of an unknown origin. However considering it was patterned of of The Ebony Blade wielded by Black Knight, it stands to reason that there is some specialty to it's design. It has been shown to be durable enough to penetrate an Asgardian's hide during the Siege story-line without breaking.

name: Tech-Pac
deck: A harness constructed out of modular weapons and components used by Techno/The Fixer. He can mentally reconfigure it on the fly, giving him access to an arsenal of thousand of weapons and gadgets.

name: Terrigen Crystals
deck: Terrigen Crystals are a mineral vital to the creation of the Terrigen Mists needed by Inhumans to undergo a Terrigenesis transformation.

name: Terrigen Mists
deck: Created by an Inhuman geneticist named Randac, the Terrigen Mists accelerate genetic advances. Inhumans are exposed to the mists when they come of age. Each experiences different results.

name: Terrigenesis Cocoon
deck: The result of exposure to the Terrigenesis compound leading to those with Inhuman genes undergoing a transformation where they enter into a cocoon and emerge as a full-blown Inhuman with powers.

name: The Collective
deck: The Collective mutant power of every mutant depowered after M-Day.

name: The Daily Bugle
deck: A popular New York newspaper in the Marvel Universe.

name: The Darkhold
deck: The Darkhold is an indestructible volume of parchments, including information about magic and spells, transcribed by The Elder God Chthon.

name: The Hood's Cloak
deck: A mystical cloak worn by Parker Robbins that once belonged to the demon known as Nisanti and has ties to Dormammu.

name: The Milano
deck: Peter Quill's spaceship.

name: The Monster Image
deck: A three dimensional holograph created by the Kronans as an illusion.

name: The Sanctuary
deck: For decades, The Sanctuary and its duplicates served as Thanos' base of operations until they were all either wrecked or destroyed. The last surviving Sanctuary ship was recently comandeered by Lord Mar-Vell and his Revengers, who plan to perform The Necropsy within its hallowed halls.

name: Thunderball's Ball and Chain
deck: Weapon used by the Wrecking Crew's Thunderball.

name: Thunderbolts' Submarine
deck: A nuclear submarine that served as a mobile base of operations for Red Hulk's Thunderbolts until it was sunk by Supergiant during Thanos' invasion of Earth.

name: Thunderstrike
deck: Thunderstrike is the enchanted mace made for Eric Masterson. It grants its bearer some of the powers of Thor.

name: Thundra's Chain
deck: Thundra's weapon of choice is her 3-foot linked chain often attached to her bracelet or used as a belt.

name: Tigra's Cat's Head Amulet
deck: A special amulet which allows Tigra to transform to and from her human and feline forms.

name: Time Cube
deck: The Time Cube is a time travel machine created by Zarrko the Tomorrow Man. Under unknown circumstances, Doctor Doom gained access to it following the destruction of his own time machine.

name: Time Gem
deck: Total control over all aspects of time including time travel, stopping time, slowing down or speed up flow of time and to accelerate or slow down aging.

name: Titanium Man Armor
deck: Composed largely of titanium, the Titanium Man armor is stronger and tougher but also heavier and slower than Iron Man's armor. The suit of armor increases the wearer's physical strength to superhuman levels.

name: Torunn's Sword
deck: An Asgardian weapon given to Torunn by her father, Thor.

name: Trick Arrow
deck: The trick arrow is an item that comes in various forms that can be used for a number of situations. Trick Arrows give Archers in the Comic Universe the advantage they need to fight alongside (or against) super-powered beings.

name: Trident of Neptune
deck: The weapon of Neptune and the symbol of Atlantean royalty. In the Marvel Universe it is held by Namor.

name: Twilight Sword
deck: The Twilight Sword was made by Surtur and is used as his weapon of destruction.

name: Two-Gun Kid's Twin Pistols
deck: The twin colt .45 pistols hold six bullets each.

name: U-Car
deck: The Fantastic Four's underwater transport created by Mr. Fantastic.

name: U.S.Agent's Gun
deck: John Walker's side-arm, a M9 Semi-Automatic.

name: U.S.Agent's Photonic Nightstick
deck: Photonic Nightstick used by U.S. Agent.

name: U.S.Agent's Shield
deck: Vibranium shield used by John Walker as the U.S. Agent.

name: U.S.Agent's Star Shaped Shield
deck: A star shaped shield with retractable spikes.

name: U.S.Agent's Vibranium/Energy Combo Shield
deck: Vibranium/Energy Combo Shield.

name: Ultimate Nullifier
deck: The Ultimate Nullifier is a device that can eliminate from existence anything that the bearer chooses. It is powerful enough to destroy entire timelines if the bearer is of sufficient intellect and power.

name: Ultron's Brain Engram Chips
deck: Chips used by Ultron to record the brain patterns of humans to use as a basis for robots.

name: Ultron's Flying Warcraft
deck: Warcraft used by Ultron to invade and decimate Slorenia.

name: Ultron's War-Platform
deck: Weaponed transport occasionally used by Ultron.

name: Universal Weapon
deck: Universal Weapons are weapons that are given to the public accusers of the Kree race. They are most closely associated with Ronan the Accuser.

name: Unstable Molecules
deck: An adaptive molecular fabric that is able to adapt to its environment and later retain its original shape.

name: Uranian's Headband
deck: Marvel Boy/Uranian's special Headband which grants him some telepathic ability and allows him to control his spaceship mentally.

name: Uru
deck: The highly durable, mystical Asgardian Ore best known for being used to forge Thor's hammer, Mjolnir. Uru is formed from the core of a dying star.

name: V-Wing (Thunderbolts)
deck: Thunderbolt's jet board with V profile. Used to transport them to other places.

name: Verdant Vial of Valtorr
deck: An artifact of power created by the demon Valtorr. The first human to touch the item is given a portion of its power, becoming Decay.

name: Vibranium
deck: Vibranium is a metal primarily found in the African nation of Wakanda. It is able to absorb any vibrations and kinetic energy directed at it as its molecules behave as if at absolute zero. Because of this, it has been a highly sought after material to be weaponized.

name: Vibranium Knives
deck: Warpath owns a pair of Vibranium Knives. They were given to him as a gift from Storm.

name: Vision's Solar Jewel
deck: The Solar Jewel absorbs solar energy to provide the needed power for Vision to function.

name: Vulture's Wings
deck: Pair of wings created by Adrian Toomes and worn by the Vulture.

name: War Machine Armor
deck: The JRXL-1000 Variable Threat Response Battle Suit was designated by Tony Stark to deal with threat of the Masters of Silence. Stark then built a suit specifically for Rhodey.

name: Wasp's Sting
deck: The Wasp's Sting is an arm mounted compressed air gun Henry Pym invented as a weapon for The Wasp.

name: Waterfall of Watoomb
deck: An empowered waterfall created by the being Watoomb. The first human to enter this waterfall is given a portion of its power, becoming Tempest.

name: Web Shooters
deck: Web Shooters are Marvel superhero Spider-Man's main defensive weapons and tools. He mainly uses this to shoot webs from his wrist, and a pair was even handed down to his daughter, May Day Parker also known as Spider-Girl.

name: Willbreaker
deck: Willbreaker is the enchanted hammer that is carried by the Absorbing Man.

name: Wonder Man's Jet-Belt
deck: Special belt worn by Wonder Man equipped with jet-packs to enable him to fly.

name: Wonder Man's Jetpack
deck: A Jetpack used by Wonder Man for a time which replaced his Jet-belt.

name: Worldbreaker
deck: Worldbreaker is the enchanted hammer that is carried by the Hulk.

name: Wrecker's Crowbar
deck: Four-foot long cast iron crowbar used by the Wrecker.

name: Yellowjacket's Stingers
deck: Disruptor stings used by both Yellowjackets as a weapon.

name: Zodiac Key
deck: Extradimensional device originating from the Dimension of the Ankh, wielded by members of the Zodiac crime cartel.
